recent_posts.title: A Git-like platform for datasets, models, and binary folders - ClearMesh
recent_posts.summary: ClearMesh is a Git-like version control platform for large binary files, datasets, model checkpoints, and media folders. It splits files into chunks stored in S3/R2-compatible object storage, enabling deduplication across versions so only changed chunks are re-uploaded. Repos can be cloned, synced, browsed via a web UI, or mounted read-only so tools access files via a normal filesystem path with on-demand chunk fetching. Built with a Rust CLI, it supports commits, branches, optional client-side encryption, and targets AI, VFX, research, and engineering teams dealing with large artifacts.

recent_posts.title: A local AI coding assistant to delegate tasks to AI agents
recent_posts.summary: Tollecode is a local-first AI coding assistant that lets developers delegate real engineering tasks to AI agents, including file reads, shell commands, and sub-agents, while maintaining full control over what executes.

recent_posts.title: PanicMode: Protect your screen in public with one shortcut
recent_posts.summary: PanicMode is a native desktop app for macOS and Windows that instantly replaces your screen with a convincing, neutral-looking workspace via a single hotkey. Designed for people working in public spaces like cafés or trains, it prevents accidental exposure of emails, chats, or sensitive data when someone walks by. Unlike minimizing windows or blur overlays, it offers fully interactive customizable workspace profiles (e.g., Developer, Office) that blend naturally with your setup.

recent_posts.title: Airbyte Agents: The context layer for production-grade AI agent
recent_posts.summary: Airbyte Agents is a context layer for production-grade AI agents that connects services like Salesforce, Stripe, and Zendesk into a queryable Context Store. It enables agents to reason across systems without stitching APIs at runtime, accessible via UI, MCP, or SDK. Claims 40% fewer tool calls and up to 80% fewer tokens.

recent_posts.title: macOS agent that turns prompts into automated clicks - Openclick
recent_posts.summary: Openclick is an experimental open-source CLI tool for macOS that uses an LLM to convert natural language prompts into automated UI actions. It generates a plan of UI interactions and executes them via macOS Accessibility APIs. The project is early-stage, MIT-licensed, and available as a command-line interface.

recent_posts.title: Learn ciphers by breaking them - CipherLock
recent_posts.summary: CipherLock is a minimalist, client-side web app for learning classical cryptography by interacting with and breaking ciphers. Built by a CS student for their thesis, it covers Caesar, Vigenère, Morse, Atbash, and Rail Fence ciphers. It includes an Academy section explaining the 'why' and 'how' of encryption, plus a Daily Enigma challenge. The project is open source, privacy-focused, and actively updated weekly.

recent_posts.title: LaunchCut: Interactive iOS Demo Builder
recent_posts.summary: LaunchCut is a macOS tool that builds interactive iOS demos using the Xcode simulator. It lets you capture screens, add clickable hotspot areas linked to other screens or animations, and export the result as a self-contained HTML file or a shareable/embeddable link — useful for landing pages and app showcases.

recent_posts.title: UI Agentic framework for quicker output & less token usage
recent_posts.summary: Montage is a runtime framework for agentic UI that replaces token-by-token UI generation with a server-side compilation approach. Instead of having AI agents regenerate UI components from scratch each turn, agents emit a small intent schema that Montage compiles into production-ready HTML/CSS/JS. Claims include 10x faster hydration, 50-100x fewer output tokens, model-agnostic and framework-agnostic support (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.), and full brand theming. Targeted at companies building customer-facing AI agents where UI generation consumes a significant portion of inference costs.

recent_posts.title: Beauty Diagram: Diagrams that don't look like they were auto-generated
recent_posts.summary: Beauty Diagram is a tool that enhances Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams with curated themes, flow animations, and export options (SVG, PNG, GIF). It offers a web editor, CLI, and API, making it easy to embed polished diagrams into docs, pull requests, and presentations.

recent_posts.title: Spec-driven testing for AI agents and AI apps
recent_posts.summary: Spec27 is an early-access validation platform for AI agents and AI applications. It moves teams away from manual, vibes-based testing by using machine-readable specifications to generate broader test coverage, catch regressions earlier, and validate both in-house and third-party systems without requiring SDK integration or code-level access.

top_posts.title: RelateDB: Offline-first database schema designer in your browser
top_posts.summary: RelateDB is a browser-based database schema designer that works entirely offline without requiring accounts or cloud services. It allows developers to visually model tables and relationships, import and export SQL or DBML formats, auto-arrange diagrams, and export schemas as images. All functionality runs locally in the browser for fast, frictionless schema design.

top_posts.title: Unosend email API for transactional and marketing emails
top_posts.summary: Unosend is an email API service designed for developers to send transactional and marketing emails. It offers 99.9% deliverability, a REST API interface, competitive pricing with 5,000 free emails per month, and positions itself as an alternative to established services like Resend and SendGrid.

top_posts.title: Easily generate beautiful UIs with HeroUI Chat
top_posts.summary: HeroUI Chat converts prompts or screenshots into production-ready React applications using AI, leveraging the open-source HeroUI library, which has over 23k stars and 600k downloads.

top_posts.title: Reindeer: Cursor for databases
top_posts.summary: Reindeer is an AI-powered IDE for database work that understands database schemas and generates production-ready SQL queries. It features autocomplete for complex SQL, automatic query fixing, and schema-aware assistance to streamline debugging and query optimization workflows without switching between tools.

top_posts.title: Appwrite - 100% open source alternative for Firebase
top_posts.summary: Appwrite provides authentication, database, storage, functions, and advanced realtime capabilities.
